releases.name: Entire Git forge for agents and humans
releases.summary: Former GitHub CEO Thomas Dohmke's Entire launched a Git-compatible forge built for coding agents. It replaces pull requests with Trails (agent-scored evals on every push), adds Continuous Memory that syncs agent sessions into the repo, and integrates with Buildkite and Depot CI. Available to every developer today.

releases.name: Runway App Studio
releases.summary: Describe a creative tool in plain language and Runway builds, tests and deploys a custom app that generates images, video and audio using your Brand Kits and Workflows. Share it with your team or publish a link; code stays visible and you can roll back versions.

releases.name: GPT-6.1 Terra in GitHub Copilot
releases.summary: OpenAI's newest model is generally available in Copilot for everyday agentic coding and terminal work at a lower cost than GPT-6.1 Sol. Available on Pro, Pro+, Max, Business and Enterprise across VS Code, Copilot CLI, cloud agent, JetBrains, Xcode and more; billed at provider list pricing.

releases.name: GitHub Copilot assisted permissions (GA)
releases.summary: When Copilot asks to run a command, touch a path or open a URL, a model evaluates the request: clearly safe ones proceed automatically, the rest still need your approval. Generally available in Copilot CLI (/permissions), the Copilot app and VS Code, with enterprise controls.

releases.name: Replit Agent workspace skills + keep apps running past credits
releases.summary: Replit Agent can now suggest new or improved workspace skills from your chats and projects, which you review and approve before they land. The same update lets eligible top-up customers keep published apps running when credits run out, up to an overage limit, and adds Stripe Atlas on Replit.

releases.name: OpenAI Agents API: Scheduled Automations
releases.summary: Schedule a message into an existing agent session or have it start a new one, using a cron expression for recurring jobs or a timestamp for one-offs. Add the automations tool and agents can create, update or remove their own schedules from natural-language requests.

releases.name: AWS Infinity agent runtime (open source)
releases.summary: An Apache-2.0 research runtime from AWS and UC Berkeley's Hydro project that suspends an agent during each tool call and resumes it when the result arrives, so idle agents cost little more than their history and can run on serverless platforms. AWS says 75,000 concurrent agents fit in a Raspberry Pi 5's 8 GB.

releases.name: GitHub app for Microsoft Teams with Copilot
releases.summary: The new consolidated GitHub app in Teams brings notifications and Copilot together: @mention GitHub on an issue notification and Copilot investigates, fixes the bug and opens a pull request. The legacy app retires on 16 November.

releases.name: TanStack AI 1.0
releases.summary: The open-source, provider-agnostic AI toolkit hits 1.0 with stable core APIs, 23 provider adapters, support for coding agents like Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode in sandboxes, plus a new experimental agent harness.

releases.name: Cursor Computer Use
releases.summary: Cursor's agents can now click and type across any desktop app on your computer, not just the browser, for example driving the iOS Simulator to test a feature they just built. The agent uses it when a task needs it, or you can @-mention Computer Use; update Cursor to get it. Desktop-app release notes weren't out yet at announcement.

releases.name: Kimi K3.1 Pro (Moonshot API)
releases.summary: Moonshot's new flagship model is live on the Kimi API at $2/$10 per 1M input/output tokens, plus a 2-3x faster Highspeed tier at twice the price. Moonshot says full open weights follow by 4 Nov 2026; Artificial Analysis scored it 55, behind only Claude Opus 5.5.

releases.name: Devin Desktop (Windsurf) new Agent Window
releases.summary: v3.11.212 rebuilds the Agent Window on the Devin web app UI: up to 8 sessions side by side, per-session Files, Changes and terminal views, cloud app previews with an element picker, and Enter to steer a running turn. v3.11.216 (24 Oct) fixes Local sessions and CLI install.

releases.name: OpenAI Codex CLI 0.164
releases.summary: Adds /presets (ten saved prompt and slash-command slots), inline arguments for /model and /permissions, image previews on Kitty/Sixel terminals, enterprise MCP sign-in, and credential masking in remote Bash, plus sandbox hardening.

releases.name: Vercel: deploy without an account
releases.summary: Run vercel deploy --temporary to get a live tmp.now URL for a project or a single file without signing in. Temporary deployments expire after one hour unless you claim the project via the link in the CLI output.

releases.name: Microsoft Copilot Code (Frontier preview)
releases.summary: A natural-language coding agent in the Microsoft Copilot app that builds apps, dashboards, tools and scripts from a description, using your work context, with a live preview, local or cloud runs, GitHub draft PRs and publishing to Copilot Managed Runtime. Rolling out via the Frontier program.

releases.name: Google Elephant-Goldfish Model plugin (open source)
releases.summary: Google open-sourced its internal design-first AI coding plugin: a long-context 'Elephant' session co-designs a spec, then stateless 'Goldfish' sessions review it before any code is written. Apache 2.0, built for Antigravity first.

releases.name: Replit Monitoring Agent
releases.summary: An autonomous on-call agent for apps published on Replit: it reads production logs and metrics, investigates alerts, validates a fix and can auto-publish it, then emails you a summary.

releases.name: Wodby Agent for vibe coding
releases.summary: Describe an app and Wodby Agent picks a stack, creates a private repo in your own GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket, builds it in a live workspace with previews, opens a PR and deploys to infrastructure you control or Wodby Cloud.

releases.name: Recursive Flint
releases.summary: Free, Apache 2.0 coding model small enough to run on a laptop (40B-parameter MoE, 2.5B active), so you can code offline and keep your code private. Download on Hugging Face.

releases.name: Claude Duet (research preview)
releases.summary: Anthropic's proactive agent app: runs tasks on its own cloud computer, sends a morning brief from your connected apps, can prototype and build web apps, and asks before sending, paying or deleting. Waitlist for US Pro and Max.

releases.name: OpenAI models and Codex on Google Cloud (private preview)
releases.summary: OpenAI's frontier models and Codex workflows are coming to Google Cloud's Model Garden, billed via Google Cloud Marketplace; private preview now, GA planned in the coming weeks.

releases.name: GemDB Code (VS Code extension)
releases.summary: Free VS Code extension with an object database where your code is the schema, so you or your coding agent change a class and commit with no migration scripts. Python only at launch; includes an MCP server.

releases.name: Vercel WebSockets in Functions (GA)
releases.summary: WebSocket support in Vercel Functions is generally available, for AI chat, streaming and realtime multiplayer apps, at normal Function pricing (CPU billed only while processing messages).

releases.name: Lovable can create your Supabase project
releases.summary: Ask Lovable to create a Supabase project for an app with no backend: pick the organisation and region and Lovable creates and connects it, billed to your own Supabase org.

releases.name: Mistral Voxtral 3 + voice agent SDK
releases.summary: New speech-to-text and text-to-speech models (50+ languages) plus a voice agent SDK that listens, reasons, calls tools and speaks in one real-time pipeline. Transcription from $0.0035/min.

releases.name: v0: Slack MCP integration
releases.summary: Connect Slack to v0 so it can use team discussions as context for a change and post updates to Slack when you ask. Available on all v0 plans.

releases.name: Perplexity Computer: REA reverse-engineering skill
releases.summary: New /reverse-engineer skill lets Computer inspect an existing app without its source and rebuild a working version, using the open-source REA MCP toolkit. Tasks free up to 10,000 credits per user until 31 Oct.

releases.name: Cursor: canvases from cloud agents + Environments API (beta)
releases.summary: Cloud agents can build shareable interactive canvases; Environments API in beta; environments now support up to 300 repos and load 5x faster.

releases.name: Chainguard Workspaces and Checks (beta)
releases.summary: Hardened microVM dev environments for developers and coding agents, plus fast in-loop CI checks agents can call via MCP or SDK. 30-day beta trials.

releases.name: Band for Developers
releases.summary: Desktop app and CLI for managing a team of coding agents at once: projects, ownership, blockers, questions and progress in one view.

releases.name: Meta Muse Spark Open
releases.summary: Coding-optimised open-weight MoE model (816B, 42B active) with 1M-token context.

releases.name: Vercel Token Pass (early access)
releases.summary: $30/month for $80 of GLM 5.3 and Kimi K3 credit via AI Gateway, for Pro teams.

releases.name: Vercel AI SDK 7
releases.summary: AI SDK becomes a provider-agnostic toolkit for building multi-turn agents, announced at Vercel Ship 2026.

releases.name: GitHub AI Scan for PRs (GA)
releases.summary: AI vulnerability scanning on pull requests, complementing CodeQL.

releases.name: GitHub agentic autofix for code scanning (GA)
releases.summary: Agents propose fixes for code scanning alerts.

releases.name: Claude Code Review (GA)
releases.summary: Multi-agent review of GitHub pull requests is out of research preview for Claude Team and Enterprise, with reviews ~3x faster (6-10 min) and Quick, Standard or Deep levels per repo.

releases.name: Lovable: AI models and tools inside your apps
releases.summary: Apps built in Lovable can now use GPT-Live voice, the latest Claude models, Gemini 4 Argon, Gemini Omni, Lyria, Perplexity, Firecrawl, Parallel and Jev without leaving Lovable.

releases.name: Bluesky Attie site builder
releases.summary: "Social vibe coding": describe a poll, quiz, guestbook or game and Attie builds a shareable page on attie.site that Bluesky followers can sign in to and use.

releases.name: Builder.io Agent-Native (beta)
releases.summary: Open-source TypeScript framework for agentic apps where the agent and UI share actions, data and state; every app is also an MCP server and supports A2A.

releases.name: Graphicle (KarLex AI)
releases.summary: Open-source Rust tool giving coding agents local code graphs and memory via MCP.

releases.name: Lovable Growth tools
releases.summary: Set a goal like 'my first 100 signups' and Lovable builds a growth plan from your app and traffic, then can create and launch ad campaigns on Google, YouTube, Facebook and Instagram with tracking set up, plus generate launch videos and ad creative. No extra Lovable fee; ad spend is billed by Google or Meta.

releases.name: Gemini 4 Argon in GitHub Copilot
releases.summary: Google's newest frontier model now GA in Copilot.

releases.name: Replit: cross-project chat + Windows Desktop preview
releases.summary: Send tasks across projects from one chat; Windows desktop app in private preview.

releases.name: Google Gemini agent
releases.summary: Universal work agent that writes and runs code, announced at Gemini at Work 2026.

releases.name: Supabase Select: code-first backend + app MCP servers
releases.summary: Schema/config in code for agents, Docker-free local Supabase (alpha), and authenticated MCP servers for your app.
